original_query: What are two approaches for Association mapping?

partials.partial_answer: LD-based Association mapping is one of the two main approaches for gene mapping.; Family-based Linkage mapping is the other main approach, but it is not an Association mapping method.
partials.summary: The page explains the purpose of gene mapping, which is to find molecular markers linked to target genes for use in marker-assisted selection (MAS). It then presents two main approaches: Family-based Linkage mapping and LD-based Association mapping, with a brief description of the former.
key_facts: LD-based Association mapping is one of the two main approaches for gene mapping.
Family-based Linkage mapping is the other main approach, but it is not an Association mapping method.
